ENGLISH

What to send us

Introduce your business and the products you would like us to consider. Links help us review claims accurately.

  • Company name, website, contact person and country of production
  • Product types, catalogue, materials and key specifications
  • Your maker story and available product imagery
  • Public certificate or test-report links, including issuer and register details where available
  • Country of manufacture, delivery markets, lead times, defect-resolution arrangements and warehouse inspection requirements you can support

Our team will review public sources and ask follow-up questions. A person approves every FI Verify report before publication.

OUR REVIEW PROCESS

A clear route from introduction to listing.

We will check the maker, evaluate product information and publish only after the relevant record is approved. We will show what was checked and what remains unconfirmed.

  • 01 / IntroduceSend your business and product information.
  • 02 / ReviewWe research public sources and follow up on unclear claims.
  • 03 / ApproveA person approves the report and listing details before publication.
  • 04 / PublishApproved records can appear in the maker directory and shop.
